title: This Fish Breathes Air and Has Two Rows of Teeth
subject: alligator gar

scenes.text: This fish breathes air. And it has two rows of teeth.
It's the alligator gar. Most grow to about seven feet long.
Rare ones reach almost ten feet and about three hundred pounds.
The second row of teeth sits on the roof of its mouth, so prey gets pinned.
It gulps air with a modified swim bladder, so it survives in muddy, low-oxygen water.
Females can live fifty years. The oldest on record was ninety-five.
